timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Quantum physics for dummies in 60 seconds.
Particles, energy, atoms don't have a definite location or speed until we measure them.
Instead, they can be in many different places or states at the exact same time.
Kind of like a ghost that can be in all rooms at once, if you will.
Another really important idea is that particles can be connected in a way that's very difficult to explain.
For example, if we have two particles that are entangled, when we measure one of them,
the other particle instantly knows what we found out when we measured that other particle.
And it doesn't even matter how far apart they are.
Think about when you're thinking of a friend and within five minutes they call you.
It's because you've had that thought and you're entangled with that person
and so they received that thought and that energy and they reached out to you.
And there's just a million different ways that this happens.
